{{Quote|Take Rio and those four mudskulls and flank them on the left. I'll take this mouthy scooch and Korso around to the right. Maybe we'll get lucky.|Tobias Beckett to Val|<ref name="Solo" />}}
'''Korso''' was a [[human]]<ref name="Solo" /> [[Gender|male]] criminal who provided muscle for [[Tobias Beckett]]'s [[Beckett's gang|gang]]. He helped Beckett to infiltrate the [[Imperial Army]] [[Mimban Campaign|fighting]] on [[Mimban]] and steal an [[Y-45 armored transport hauler]] for a [[heist on Vandor]] in exchange for passage off the [[planet]].<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> On Mimban Korso wore [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[swamp trooper]] [[armor]], an [[Imperial Navy Trooper|Imperial fleet trooper]] [[helmet]], and an [[Imperial officer]] [[greatcoat]] and used a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]]. During a battle, Korso was present in a trench next to his team members [[Val]], Beckett and [[Rio Durant]]. While Beckett—who was disguised as an [[Imperial Army]] [[captain]]—was speaking to his crew, the [[corporal]] [[Han Solo]] informed him that he was now the highest [[commanding officer]] on site after the [[major]] [[Staz]] had been [[Death|killed]] by a [[missile]] minutes earlier. Beckett then led the Imperial [[soldier]]s in a charge forward.<ref name="Solo" /> During the fight, Korso was attacked by a [[Mimbanese Liberation Army|Mimbanese]] man and was grappling on the ground with them, when they were both shot by a different soldier. Solo and Beckett were able to drag Korso's body in a trench, but he was already dead.<ref name="Expanded Edition" /> His place on the team for the heist was eventually replaced by Solo and the former [[Slavery|enslaved]] [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]].<ref name="Solo" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Korso was played by [[Wikipedia:New Zealand|New Zealand]] actor [[John Tui]] in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> According to screenwriter [[Jon Kasdan]], Tui's performance was great, but given the hectic environment of the scene, it became confusing to introduce Korso as he was going to immediately get killed off. The sequence of Korso's death is featured in the film's [[Content cut from Star Wars|Deleted Scenes.]] The character's original logic, as a larger man, was that Beckett's gang had lost their muscle and Beckett saw Chewbacca as a useful replacement.<ref name="Jon's Twitter">{{Twitter|JonKasdan|status/1040529501870944256|[[Jon Kasdan]]|quote=In honor of the digital release of #SoloAStarWarsStory & in lieu of a commentary, here are 53 random factoids & notes about the making & writing for anybody who's interested. If you haven't seen the movie yet... maybe watch it before reading? Anyway, enjoy the movie & #MTFBWY|archivefile=File:Jon-Kasdan-SoloFacts-September-14-2018.png|nolive=1}}</ref> An early version of the ''Solo'' script had Korso as [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] older brother.<ref name="Jon's Twitter 2">{{Twitter|JonKasdan|status/1168287139848773639|[[Jon Kasdan]]|quote=KORSO. The muscle in Beckett's crew who died in battle shortly after they crash-landed on Mimban. Korso was in every draft of the script (including an early version where he was Lando's big brother) and every cut of the movie 'til just before lock when he was removed to simplify.|archivedate=20200421172446|nolive=1}}</ref>
